svg.title: CampusNova database architecture
svg.desc: Entity-relationship diagram of the 12 Postgres tables, 2 views and 6 enums in supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql. Every row belongs to a course or a team: courses own teams and enrollments, teams own members, tasks, messages, files, peer reviews, conflict alerts and task suggestions. Users teach courses, enroll, join teams and receive notifications.
svg.text: Postgres schema in supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql · 12 tables, 2 views, 6 enums · every table has Row-Level Security

g.text: PK primary key · FK foreign key · uuid → users foreign key to users.id, line left out for readability · ? nullable · colors are tokens from globals.css
